narr: Heavy rain associated with Post-Tropical Cyclone Fred caused flash flooding in eastern Pennsylvania on the night of August 18-19, 2021. There were rainfall totals as high as 3 to 5 inches.
ev: Pinehurst Road in Bethlehem was closed due to flooding.
Weaversville Road in Hanover Township was closed due to flooding.
A section of PA Route 145 in North Whitehall Township was closed due to flooding.
Flood waters reached some homes in Bangor.
Two vehicles were stranded in flood waters at the intersection of Madison Avenue and Tyler Avenue in Phoenixville.
Minesite Road in Wescosville was closed due to flooding.
A water rescue took place on First Avenue in Royersford.
Moderate flooding occurred along the Frankford Creek in Philadelphia.
A water rescue took place on the Pennsylvania Turnpike near Little Conestoga Road in Upper Uwchlan Township.
A water rescue took place at the intersection of West Elm Street and Maple Street in Conshohocken.
Keith Valley Road in Horsham Township was closed due to flooding.
A water rescue took place on River Road in Valley Forge.
A water rescue took place at the intersection of Grubb Road and Davis Road in Willistown Township.
Two water rescues took place in Abington, one on Highland Avenue and the other on Brook Road. A third water rescue occurred at the intersection of Easton Road and Woodland Road in Abington.
Widespread roadway flooding occurred in East Whiteland Township, including Conestoga Road, North Bacton Hill Road and Planebrook Road.
Minor flooding occurred along the East Branch of the Brandywine Creek between West Bradford Township and East Bradford Township.
Philmont Avenue was closed near Pine Road in Lower Moreland Township due to flooding.
A water rescue took place on the Hollow Road ramp to the Schuylkill Expressway in Lower Merion Township.
PA Route 447 was closed near PA Route 191 to the north of Analomink due to flooding.

A water rescue took place on US Route 202 near the US Route 30 Bypass in West Whiteland Township. Valley Road was under water at Valley Creek. Several vehicles were trapped in flood waters on the Lincoln Highway near the Pottstown Pike in West Whiteland Township. Rocks and debris were washed onto Cockerham Lane by flood waters.
A water rescue took place on North Gulph Road in King of Prussia.
A water rescue took place on DeKalb Street in Bridgeport. US Route 202 was closed in Bridgeport due to flooding.
Moderate flooding occurred along Valley Creek near Valley Forge.
A water rescue took place at the intersection of Paper Mill Road and Harston Lane in Flourtown.
A water rescue took place on Ashmead Road in Cheltenham.
Minor flooding occurred along the Wissahickon Creek in Philadelphia.

Three water rescues took place in West Chester. One was at the intersection of East Gay Street and Montgomery Avenue, another was at the intersection of South Bolmar Street and Union Street, and a final one was at the intersection of Union Street and South Franklin Street.

A water rescue took place at the intersection of Sugartown Road and Morris Road in Radnor Township. Also, there was widespread roadway flooding in Radnor Township with multiple vehicles trapped in the flood waters. There was a rockslide on Strafford Avenue near Lancaster Avenue.
Moderate flooding occurred along Cobbs Creek in Philadelphia.
Minor flooding occurred along the Pennypack Creek in Northeast Philadelphia.

A water rescue took place at the intersection of US Route 202 and North Valley Road in Tredyffrin Township. Another water rescue took place at the intersection of Old Eagle School Road and Wallace Drive. A third water rescue took place at the intersection of Duportail Road and Mill Road in Tredyffrin Township.

Three water rescues took place in Paoli, one at the intersection of East Lancaster Avenue and Leopard Road, another at the intersection of Maple Avenue and Agnew Lane, and a final one at the intersection of Paoli Pike and Rustic Lane.
Coffeetown Road was closed at Orefield Road in South Whitehall Township due to flooding.
